data.gender_notes: Dayanita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dayanita is derived from the Sanskrit words 'daya' and 'nidhi'. 'Dayah' means compassion and 'nidhi' means treasure. Thus, the name Dayanita signifies a compassionate treasure or a treasure of compassion. The name Dayanita carries the meaning “Daya (compassion) + Nidhi (treasure)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayanita usually hope their child will grow to embody daya (compassion) + nidhi (treasure) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion and nurturing love.
data.etymology: Dayanita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daya (compassion) + Nidhi (treasure).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayanita total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Dayanita was a renowned Tantric practitioner and yogini from the Kamarupa region, now Assam, India. She is often considered a patron goddess of the Ahom kings, who ruled the region from 1228 to 1826 CE. Her worship was widespread amongst the Ahom royalty and nobility.
